title: 第551章 出世第550章 复活3
lines: 随着那道身影出现在视线中，周围的空气仿佛在一瞬间凝固住了，所有人的目光都聚集到了那道挺拔的身影上。
“快看，是沈先生。”听到邵海生的提醒，海流沙一行人举目看去，只见沈逸飞躺在地上，一只脚被对方抓着，在地面慢慢的拖行，所到之处，留下一道醒目的血迹。
虽然隔得比较远，看不清沈逸飞的具体情况，但可以想象得到，他的下场一定十分凄惨。
此时，在远处的两顶帐篷中，还未来得及撤离的宋成辉和袁弘接到消息，立刻从帐篷中赶了出来。看着孤傲笔挺的那道身影，二人的脸色瞬间变得难看起来。他们本想借助利用其他人拖延下时间，没想到还是迟了。
“傅余庵，带着你的手下，尽量给我们争取撤离的时间。”袁弘当机立断，做出了决定，“没有我的命令前，就算战死到最后一个人，你们也不准撤退，听到没有？”
听到这话，傅余庵不由有些犹豫，事到如今，谁不重视自己的性命，明知是死，还要慷慨赴死，那除非是脑子有毛病。见他迟迟没有回应，袁弘眉头一皱，冷声喝道：“我说的话难道你没有听清楚？”
“是。”傅余庵点了点头，很是敷衍的回道：“我会尽力而为。”嘴上虽然这么说，但他心里已经打好主意了，只要一有机会，他会毫不犹豫的撤离。没办法，就算他甘心去送死，他手下的人也不会愿意。
“水墨，水琉璃，我把夜狼的精英都交给你们，无论如何，一定要制止住他。”不远处，宋成辉也下达了同样的命令。
“狼主，那家伙太变态了，你让我们跟他斗，那不是送死吗？”水墨面色一变，急忙说道：“狼主，我们兄妹对你忠心耿耿，希望能让我们留在你身边，贴身保护你。”
宋成辉目光冷厉的扫了他一眼，“你想违抗我的命令？水墨，别忘了夜狼的规矩，谁要敢抗命，后果你是清楚的。”顿了顿，他话锋一转，“放心，只要你能活着回去，我以后绝不会亏待你。”
“狼主……”水墨张了张嘴，还想再说什么，却听一旁的水琉璃开口道：“请狼主放心，我们兄妹保证完成任务。”说这话的时候，她还不忘给水墨使了个眼色，让他别违逆对方。在宋成辉身边呆了那么久，她很清楚对方的性格，如果他们不顺从，下场仍旧是一死，倒不如先答应再见机行事。
“数千年了，我终于脱困了。”此刻，众人视线中的那名男子背负着双手，昂首挺胸，双目上扬，眺望着远方的碧空，深深的吸了一口气。过了好一会，他收回目光，环视着周围的道门中人，嘴角微微扬起，“你们都是为了禁忌力量而来？”说到这，他自顾自的点点头，“禁忌力量就在我体内，谁要是臣服于我，我可以赐予他力量，让他享有永生。”
此话一出，人群中立刻引起了一阵骚动，大家交头接耳，都在讨论着对方的提议。永生，这么好的条件，恐怕没几个人不愿意接受。只是，虽然有不少人心动，却迟迟没有人站出来投诚，众人面面相视，似乎谁都不敢当这个出头鸟。
“没人吗？”男子环视了一眼，嘴角带着一丝不屑和嘲弄，“我给了你们机会，既然你们放弃了，那就怪不得我了。你们这里谁是为首的，站出来让我看看。”
伴随他的话音落下，众人的目光立刻投向了夜狼和女娲的营地。感受到那名男子的注视，傅余庵和水墨兄妹的脸色顿时变得铁青无比，情不自禁的往后退了两步，只要情况不对，他们会毫不迟疑的开溜。
“嗯？”这个时候，那名男子好像察觉到了什么，身形一动，瞬间到了女娲和夜狼的营地上方。紧接着，他手腕一抖，搭建在地面的帐篷仿佛被一阵狂风袭过，全都被席卷开来，原本躲藏在帐篷中的人立刻显露了出来。
此刻，宋成辉和袁弘在一众强者的簇拥下，抬头看着对方，脸上渐渐泛起一丝苍白之色。虽然对方还没有出手，但他们已经感觉到一股无形而恐怖的威压从天而降，笼罩在他们的头顶，就连呼吸都变得不顺畅了，好像胸口被压着一块巨石，很是难受。
“你们的实力都还不错，为什么要龟缩在里面，难道不敢出来见我？”
宋成辉微皱着眉头，沉声道：“我不管你是谁，咱们井水不犯河水，让我走，你想做什么随你的便，我绝不插手。”
“走？”男子轻笑了一声，摇着头道：“恐怕没那么好的事，想走可以，除非你跪下来向我效忠，否则的话，你们谁都别想离开。”
“向你效忠？”宋成辉冷冷一笑，“我看你是在做梦的。我知道你实力不凡，不过，我们有这么多人，真要动起手来，鹿死谁手还不一定。”
“你这是在质疑我掌握的力量？”男子缓缓点头，“好吧，既然如此，那我就让你见识一下禁忌力量的真实面目。”话落，他双臂展开的，手心朝上，口中念念有词。
霎时间，天地间风起云涌，磅礴而精纯的天地灵气在这一刻尽数汇聚，与此同时，在方圆两公里内，突然出现了大量的氤氲雾气，犹如滚滚云层，从地面凭空显现，直通碧空，就像一张巨大的网，将所有人都包裹在了里面。谁要是想逃出去，必须突破那层桎梏。
当这张巨网凝聚成形后，一股恐怖的威势从四面八方狂涌而来，疯狂的冲击着众人。一些修为较弱的道门中人直接遭受到重创，口中鲜血狂吐不止，瞬间瘫倒在了地上。
看到这一幕，所有人的心都沉到了谷底。对方所掌握的力量早已经超出了大家认知的极限，单凭他们这些血肉之躯，就算拼劲全力，也不过是垂死挣扎，那些原本高高在上的神境强者，在这股恐怖的力量面前，就像一个三岁孩子，毫无反抗之力。
content_en:
As that figure appeared in sight, the surrounding air seemed to freeze for an instant, and everyone's eyes focused on the tall figure.
"Look, it's Mr. Shen." Hearing Shao Haisheng's reminder, Hai Liusha and the others looked up and saw Shen Yifei lying on the ground, one foot being grabbed by the other party, and he was slowly dragged along the ground, leaving a conspicuous trail of blood wherever he went.
虽然隔得比较远，看不清沈逸飞的具体情况，但可以想象得到，他的下场一定十分凄惨。
At this time, in two tents in the distance, Song Chenghui and Yuan Hong, who had not yet had time to evacuate, received the news and immediately rushed out of the tents. Looking at the arrogant and upright figure, their expressions instantly became ugly. They originally wanted to use other people to delay the time, but unexpectedly it was still too late.
"Fu Yu'an, take your men and try to buy us time to evacuate." Yuan Hong made a decisive decision and said, "Without my order, even if the last person is killed, you are not allowed to retreat. Do you hear me?"
Hearing this, Fu Yu'an couldn't help but hesitate. At this point, whoever doesn't value his own life and would die generously despite knowing that he is going to die must have something wrong with his brain. Seeing that he didn't respond for a long time, Yuan Hong frowned and shouted coldly: "Didn't you hear what I said clearly?"
"Yes." Fu Yu'an nodded and replied perfunctorily: "I will do my best." Although he said this, he had already made up his mind. As long as he had the opportunity, he would evacuate without hesitation. There is no way, even if he is willing to die, his people will not be willing.
"Shui Mo, Shui Liuli, I hand over the elites of Night Wolf to you. No matter what, you must stop him." Not far away, Song Chenghui also issued the same order.
"Lord Wolf, that guy is too perverted. If you let us fight him, wouldn't that mean we are going to die?" Shui Mo's expression changed and he said hurriedly: "Lord Wolf, our brothers and sisters are loyal to you. We hope that we can stay by your side and protect you personally."
Song Chenghui glanced at him sternly, "You want to disobey my order? Shui Mo, don't forget Yelang's rules. If you dare to disobey, you know the consequences." After a pause, he changed the subject, "Don't worry, as long as you can go back alive, I will never treat you badly in the future."
"Lord Wolf..." Shui Mo opened his mouth and wanted to say something else, but Shui Liuli on the side said, "Lord Wolf, please rest assured, we brothers and sisters promise to complete the mission." When she said this, she did not forget to give Shui Mo a wink to tell him not to disobey him. After staying with Song Chenghui for so long, she knew the other party's character very well. If they didn't comply, they would still end up dead, so it was better to agree first and wait until they met.
"After thousands of years, I am finally out of trouble." At this moment, the man in everyone's sight put his hands behind his back, held his head high, raised his eyes, looked at the blue sky in the distance, and took a deep breath.过了好一会，他收回目光，环视着周围的道门中人，嘴角微微扬起，“你们都是为了禁忌力量而来？”说到这，他自顾自的点点头，“禁忌力量就在我体内，谁要是臣服于我，我可以赐予他力量，让他享有永生。”
As soon as these words came out, there was a commotion in the crowd. Everyone was whispering to each other and discussing each other's proposals. Eternal life, such a good condition, I am afraid that few people are not willing to accept it. However, although many people were moved, no one came forward to surrender. Everyone looked at each other, as if no one dared to take the lead.
"Is there no one?" The man glanced around, with a hint of disdain and ridicule at the corner of his mouth, "I gave you a chance. Since you gave up, you can't blame me. Who of you is the leader here, stand up and let me see."
As his words fell, everyone's eyes immediately turned to Yelang and Nuwa's camp. Feeling the man's gaze, the faces of Fu Yu'an and Shui Mo brother and sister suddenly turned livid, and they couldn't help but take two steps back. As long as the situation was not right, they would run away without hesitation.
"Huh?" At this time, the man seemed to have noticed something. He moved and instantly reached the camp of Nuwa and Yelang. Then, with a flick of his wrist, the tent set up on the ground seemed to be hit by a strong wind, and all were swept away. The people who were originally hiding in the tent were immediately revealed.
At this moment, Song Chenghui and Yuan Hong, surrounded by a group of powerful men, looked up at each other, with a pale color gradually appearing on their faces. Although the opponent has not taken action yet, they have already felt an invisible and terrifying coercion descending from the sky, shrouding their heads. Even breathing has become unsmooth, as if a huge stone is pressing on their chests, which is very uncomfortable.
"You are all pretty good, why are you hiding in there? Don't you dare to come out to see me?"
Song Chenghui frowned slightly and said in a deep voice: "I don't care who you are, we don't interfere with each other, let me go, you can do whatever you want, I will never interfere."
"Leave?" The man chuckled, shook his head and said, "I'm afraid it's not that good. You can leave if you want. Unless you kneel down and pledge your allegiance to me, otherwise, none of you can even think of leaving."
"Loyal to you?" Song Chenghui smiled coldly, "I think you are dreaming. I know you are very powerful, but there are so many of us. If we really want to take action, it is not certain who will win."
"Are you questioning the power I have?" The man nodded slowly, "Okay, if that's the case, then I'll let you see the true face of the forbidden power." When he finished speaking, he spread his arms, palms facing up, and muttered something.
In an instant, winds and clouds surged between the sky and the earth, and the majestic and pure spiritual energy of heaven and earth gathered at this moment. At the same time, within a radius of two kilometers, a large amount of mist suddenly appeared, like rolling clouds, appearing out of thin air from the ground, straight into the blue sky, like a huge net, wrapping everyone in it. Anyone who wants to escape must break through those shackles.
When this giant network was condensed and formed, a terrifying power surged from all directions, impacting everyone crazily. Some members of the Taoist sect with weaker cultivation levels suffered severe injuries directly, vomiting blood from their mouths, and instantly collapsed to the ground.
Seeing this scene, everyone's hearts sank to the bottom. The power possessed by the other party has already exceeded the limit of everyone's understanding. With their flesh and blood bodies, even if they try their best, they are just struggling to death. Those powerful gods who were originally aloof are like a three-year-old child in the face of this terrifying power, with no resistance.
